An album of encounters.

/Project Overview/ From New Media Stage Concept to Six Live Performance

WHAT WE DO

See sound.

Enter light.

Echo Space brings classical music into a three-

dimensional environment of projections and

translucent screens. Musicians remain visible

within moving images while colour, light and

visual narratives unfold around them.

The proposal connects AIGC and digital image

production with live cueing. A library of visual

scenes allows the stage to shift with the

atmosphere of the music.
